item.title: Eala eyes redemption at Dubai Championships
item.description: MANILA, Philippines — Bouncing back from an early exit in the Qatar Open, Alex Eala shifts focus to the WTA 1000 Dubai Championships in the United Arab Emirates from Feb 15-21 — her final stop in the Middle East swing. Eala's Qatar Open run ended abruptly as she fell to Tereza Valentova 7-6 (6), 6-1 in the first round at the Khalifa International Tennis and Squash Complex. The Filipino tennis star struggled to maintain her momentum against the Czech Republic's Valentova.“Salamat, mga Kababayan!
